title.zh: 将马尼拉市Guipit公共广场的名称正式变更为Cayetano Arellano广场的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Plaza Guipit in the City of Manila to Cayetano Arellano
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Plaza Guipit in the City of Manila to Cayetano Arellano

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1948/ra_322_1948.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: In order to perpetuate the memory of the greatest jurist this country has ever produced—that pure and erudite Titan of Philippine jurisprudence—the late first Chief Justice Cayetano Arellano, who, more than any other man in our history, made of the Supreme Court of the Philippines the torchlight and fountain-head of dignity, purity, and integrity in our judicial structure, the Plaza now called Guipit in the City of Manila shall henceforth to be known as Plaza Cayetano Arellano.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1948.
